title: SourceCodeAction
responsibility: Opens the selected entity source through its host without changing catalog navigation.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.entity
inputs.description: Entity whose owned files should be read.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.nav
inputs.description: Revision-scoped navigation including an optional source callback.

inputs.name: SourceCodeAction.title
inputs.description: Optional displayed callable or entity name.

outputs.name: SourceCodeAction
outputs.description: Accessible View code action outside entity links; disabled when the host has no source action.
